title: The four colonies share one quest template: no per-colony story (Tom 17:12 #9)
repro: tools/gen_colonies.py COL: every colony is the same 5 steps (3-line elder intro -> hand over supplies -> kill N of anything -> light 3-4 beacons with Refined Crystals -> boss at crystal). Only the nouns change. Colony.gd has no per-colony beats, no choices, no mid-quest dialogue (elder just prints _status counters).
fix: Give each colony its own story arc in gen_colonies.py data (beats list per colony: 4-6 steps with their own dialogue, a local character problem, a reveal tying it to the Dark Crystal/Crystopia, e.g. coral: the grey reef is a converted reef crystal; kelp: the sunken bell; ice: the copies are lost Frostfin cats; ember: the never-out fire lit from the falling star - reuse the existing secrets.gd lore pages as seeds). Colony.gd runs a generic beat list (step id, need/kill/visit/talk, lines) instead of the fixed give/kill/beacon trio; keep run['colonies'] keys and migrate.
needs_tom: Approve or tweak the four colony story outlines before writing (Tom's daughter's ideas may shape them).

title: No island side quests at all
repro: data/quests.json has 0 mentions of colony/reef/merk; every colony region has npcs: [] (only the elder and the shop talk; the kits from _colony_village are non-talking sprites). Tom 17:12 #9 asks for 'plenty of island side quests'.
fix: Add 3-4 side quests per colony in gen_colonies.py (talkable merkitty villagers/kits as givers placed via regions 'npcs' or colony things): lost kit, fishing request with island fish, salvage from wreck, coral garden replant, after-the-crystal follow-ups so the island stays alive post-completion. Route them through the existing quest system so QuestTracker points at them.
art_needed: Talk portraits for 2-3 merkitty villagers per colony if the kits' sprites lack portraits.

title: No underwater caverns, glowing coral caves or unique sea items/recipes on the islands
repro: Colony regions have no water_blobs, no exits besides the ferry, no cave/dive area. Items: only coral_charm, tide_pearl, kelp_wrap, frost_lily, ember_glass, starfish_snack - no coral varieties, no glow items, no recipes using them. Story ch4 even promises 'under-mountain ocean tunnels' that are never playable. Tom 17:12 #9 explicitly asks for underwater caverns, glowing caves with different corals, unique items for new recipes.
fix: Add one underwater/glow cave sub-area per colony (dive spot thing in each colony needing the tail -> new colony_<id>_deep region via gen_colonies.py, cave light/'cave': true, coral props per colour, glow forage), 3+ new coral/sea materials per island and recipes that use them (gen_stations.py), plus a hidden pocket in each. Optional: make the ch4 under-mountain tunnel a short playable swim.
art_needed: Underwater cave tileset/seamless floor, coral clusters (pink, blue, gold, violet), glow anemones, kelp columns, bubble fx, icons for new coral/sea items.
audio_needed: Underwater ambience bed (muffled) and a cave music track or variant per colony.
needs_tom: Scope: one deep cave per colony now (C7) vs full underwater layer later (C14)?

title: Timeline hole: colonies playable from chapter 2, before the hero first meets the merkitties in chapter 4
repro: Colony.ferry allows Coral Reach at progress_tier 1 (after clear_meadow). Chapter 4 beat p4_merkitties (data/story.json penguins[3]) then has Mer meet the party as strangers and 'share our merkitty magic'. Elders never mention Mer, the necklace or the hero's tail, and Mer never mentions the four colonies she presumably belongs to. Tom #7: all timelines must match, no plot holes.
fix: Pick one order and wire it: either gate the ferry behind merkitty_done (Mer introduces the colonies and Pip's ferry at the end of p4_merkitties), or keep early access and add a flag-aware line on both sides (elders: 'a land-walker with no tail...' before; Mer in ch4: 'you're the one who helped Coral Reach!' if colony done). Explain how the under-mountain merkitties relate to the island colonies.
needs_tom: Should the colonies open only after chapter 4 (simplest seamless timeline)?

title: Kelp Hollow's Tideswim reward duplicates the chapter-4 merkitty tail
repro: p4_merkitties sets mermaid_gift (Companion.has_ability('tail') -> swim anywhere). Colony Kelp's ability 'tideswim' = 'swim in any deep water, no partner needed'; after ch4 it does nothing new (game_map.can_swim_cell only differs by ignoring swim_ok).
fix: Give Kelp Hollow a different, still-useful reward (e.g. breath/dive deeper into the new underwater caves, faster swimming, or underwater foraging), and reword its desc. Keep the flag id for saves.

title: The four colony elders are not in the finale (Guide 11 Q11)
repro: Guide 11 Q11 default + Tom 17:12 (11): the four elders, very old but youthful and sprightly like Catkins, come to the finale together. Grep of story.json: Brine/Tidewhisker/Icewhisker/Cinderpaw never appear; the finale only has finargle_elder. Their colony lines also read as frail ('Grandmother', 'Old Tidewhisker') with no ancient-magic, elf-like characterisation.
fix: Give the elders an ancient, sprightly voice in gen_colonies.py intro/thanks lines (thousands of years old, ancient star-magic, link to Catkins' guardian line), and add a finale beat (penguin chapter 5) where the elders of saved colonies appear together (fallback line when none saved). Story generator/beat data, not hand JSON if a generator exists.

title: Colony enemies don't match the foe the elder names, and aren't Grumps
repro: Kelp 'Shadow serpents' spawns river_serpent + wisp + slime; Frostfin 'Ice wisps' spawns ice_wisp + hill_wolf + crystal_baby; Emberclaw 'Lantern moths' spawns lantern_moth + geode_golem + shard. Every kill counts toward 'The X are driven off'. Tom 17:12 (1)/(30): key foes are converted crystals (Grumps); the island campaigns already use grump_coral/frost/ember (gen_battles GRUMP_AT) but the islands themselves don't.

title: Coral Reach story beats missing: concrete outline
repro: Coral Reach today: 3 intro lines, give 6 fish, kill 8 of crab/slime/serpent, light 3 beacons, fight 'The Grey Reef'. No characters, no reveal, no reason the reef turned grey.
fix: Beats: (1) Grandmother Brine (ancient, sprightly, sings) greets you; a kit, Shelly, is missing. (2) Find Shelly in the Tide Pools hiding from grey crabs; she says the reef 'started whispering' after a black pearl washed up. (3) Feed the kits (fish need) at a beach supper scene. (4) Light the 3 tide beacons; each one lit plays a verse of the reef song (Brine teaches it). (5) Dive to the reef shrine (new underwater area) and find the black pearl lodged in the crystal: the Dark Crystal's seed. (6) Boss The Grey Reef = the reef's own crystal heart, converted; Meow Pow Wow line turns it back into a coral crystal sprite who stays as a shrine keeper. Reward + Brine's thanks naming Catkins' guardian line ('the old cats on the mountain taught us that song').

title: Kelp Hollow story beats missing: concrete outline
repro: Kelp Hollow: plank/rope need, 10 'shadow serpents' (spawns serpent/wisp/slime), 3 beacons, boss Black Tide. The campaign mentions a 'Sunken Bell' node that the island never uses.
fix: Beats: (1) Old Tidewhisker (centuries old, does handstands on the stilts) asks for plank/rope to shore the stilt-houses (a build-site prop that changes overnight like community farm builds). (2) The Sunken Bell: dive and raise the colony's bell; ringing it calls the shoals and ties to the main story's tower bell (Tom #7: the bell motif). (3) Murkfin, the campaign captain, survives and sulks in the kelp; talk him down instead of fighting (choice, all-ages). (4) Beacons light a path through the dark kelp (underwater). (5) Boss Black Tide unwinds from the crystal; after the win the black kelp turns back into Kelp Hollow's lost guardian eels, now friendly.

title: Frostfin Isle story beats missing: concrete outline
repro: Frostfin: wood/coal need, 10 'ice wisps' (spawns wisp/wolf/crystal_baby), 4 beacons, boss Hollow Winter (clones of you). Coldy is listed as a campaign leader for colony_ice (gen_battles LEAD) but never appears on the island.
fix: Beats: (1) Captain Icewhisker (spry, ice-skates everywhere) and Coldy (story penguin) together; Coldy recognises the frost pattern from your gate (ties to ch3 Crystal Knight frost). (2) Relight the hearths (need) - a warm-up cutscene in the lodge. (3) 'Lights under the ice' (the existing secrets.gd page): cut an ice hole and dive to find frozen frostfin cats in the ice caves; free them one per beacon. (4) Boss Hollow Winter copies you: the reveal is it's a crystal that only knew loneliness; converted, it becomes the isle's snow spirit. (5) Icewhisker gives Lull with a lesson line linking to Catkins' meditation practice.

title: Emberclaw Atoll story beats missing: concrete outline
repro: Emberclaw: glass/silver need, 12 'lantern moths' (spawns moth/golem/shard), 4 beacons, boss The Smother. The lore page 'one fire that has never gone out, lit from the falling star' is never used in the quest.
fix: Beats: (1) Lady Cinderpaw (thousands of years old, runs the glassworks, cartwheels over hot sand) asks for vent patches (need). (2) The Never-Out Fire is guttering: carry an ember through the lava tubes (timed escort, safe failure) to relight it. (3) The moths are drawn to the dying crystal: lure them with a lantern instead of killing (optional pacifist count). (4) Beacons around the cone. (5) Boss The Smother; after the win Cinderpaw reveals the four crystals were once one star (pays off the carved stone) and gives the first clue to the Star Crystal's history, setting up the four-elders finale.
